subject: Sterile Site: Offline update acceptance & transport validation
messages:
From: Sophie Liao <sophie.liao@shoreline-tech.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.example, marissa_cole@redwood.example
Cc: infra_ops@grandharbor.com
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 22:12:00 +0000
Subject: Offline update plan & transport acceptance window

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough on Friday. We have one last round of operational checkpoints before Procurement signs the offline delivery agreement for the sterile site at Terminal 4. Can you confirm the exact contents you will be shipping, the signing key thumbprint we should verify on arrival, and the target acceptance window so our on-site ops team can schedule the locked-room access?

Key asks from our side: 
- A manifest file listing images/artifacts, checksums (SHA256), and the public key fingerprint used to sign bundles.
- A transport checklist (receipt, seal verification, chain-of-custody steps).
- A short runbook for field validation (smoke tests) we can run in the acceptance window (30–45 min preferred).

Procurement and Legal would like to review the manifest + docuSign once the manifest is signed by your keys.

Sophie
Lead, Platform Ops
Shoreline Tech
[Attachment: current-terminal-config.pdf (PDF, 95KB)]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.example
To: Sophie Liao <sophie.liao@shoreline-tech.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.example
Cc: evelyn_hart@redwood.example, jonas_weber@redwood.example
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 08:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Offline update plan & transport acceptance window

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clear list. Attaching the initial artifacts and a proposed acceptance timeline. Summary below.

Attachments included:
- signed-manifest.yaml (contains image names, versions, SHA256 checksums, and the signing-signer metadata)
- transport-checklist.pdf (chain-of-custody + carrier handoff checklist)

Signing key thumbprint: SHA256: 9A:2F:4C:1D:...:E8 (shortened in email; full fingerprint in signed-manifest.yaml)
Target acceptance windows we can support next week (all windows are 2-hour blocks):
- Tue 2026-11-10 13:00–15:00 UTC
- Wed 2026-11-11 09:00–11:00 UTC

Notes / constraints:
- Artifacts are signed with our offline signing key (HSM-backed). The signed-manifest includes the DER-encoded signing certificate and the chain.
- We will provide a sealed transport crate with tamper-evident straps and a manifest printed on waterproof paper.
- Field validation runbook is intentionally short: image signature verify, boot smoke test (health / model-load), and tokenized inference sanity check. Full regression suite is done in staging prior to shipment.

Happy to jump on a quick 20m call if you want to walk through the manifest.

— Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: signed-manifest.yaml (YAML, 12KB)]
[Attachment: transport-checklist.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.example
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.example, Sophie Liao <sophie.liao@shoreline-tech.com>
Cc: evelyn_hart@redwood.example
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 15:27:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Offline update plan & transport acceptance window

Sophie, Karthik — quick additions from the deployment ops perspective: 

1) Acceptance test steps (short version we will ask GH to run):
   - Verify signed-manifest.yaml signature: redwood-signer v1.2 fingerprint 9A:2F:4C...E8
   - Validate SHA256 checksums for each image blob
   - Boot image in isolated VLAN on acceptance host, run smoke check script (10 min)
   - Confirm KV cache persistence across a restart (5 min)

2) Evidence collected at handoff: photos of crate seals, on-site signer name + badge ID, manifest signed by recipient (PDF), and the output of runbook checks (console log).

3) We recommend a fallback policy: if smoke tests fail, the crate is quarantined and our remote support team will guide a rollback using the offline rollback bundle included in crate v2.

Can Grand Harbor please confirm which acceptance window works and who will be the on-site signer? We will prep the docuSign envelope once they confirm.

Marissa Cole
Senior Program Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: field-validation-runbook.md (MD, 8KB)]

From: Sophie Liao <sophie.liao@shoreline-tech.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.example, karthik_iyer@redwood.example
Cc: Legal <contracts@grandharbor.com>, Grand Harbor Infra <infra_ops@grandharbor.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 11:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Offline update plan & transport acceptance window

Thanks — GH confirms Wed 2026-11-11 09:00–11:00 UTC for acceptance. On-site signer: Marco DeLuca (Badge ID: GH-4312). Procurement has created the docuSign envelope and Legal wants the signed-manifest.pdf attached to the envelope before routing. DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/Signing/Start?env=prod&doc=GH-1123

A couple small asks from Legal: please include a brief statement in the manifest about retention (we keep signed manifests + proof-of-delivery for 7 years) and confirm whether logs from the field validation will include any customer PII (they should not).

Sophie

[Attachment: docuSign-offer-GH-1123.pdf (PDF, 220KB)]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.example
To: Sophie Liao <sophie.liao@shoreline-tech.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.example, evelyn_hart@redwood.example, jonas_weber@redwood.example
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:24:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Offline update plan & transport acceptance window

All — confirmed and thanks for the quick turnaround. Final checklist of next steps before shipment: 

1) Karthik: update signed-manifest.yaml to include retention note and regenerate signed-manifest.pdf for DocuSign (will do today).
2) Marissa: embed the field-validation log export stub in the runbook (no PII; will scrub identifiers) and package with transport crate.
3) Evelyn / Jonas: coordinate the sealed crate courier pick-up on Tue 2026-11-10 UTC window and provide tracking to GH infra.

We will notify once the docuSign envelope is sent. Marco DeLuca should expect a printed manifest and a QR link to the verification page (https://app.redwood.example/secure/manifests/GH-1123) — verification page shows the signing certificate and checksums.

If anything changes to the acceptance window please flag immediately.

— Karthik
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: signed-manifest.pdf (PDF, 14KB)]
